name: Spendesk
summary: Spendesk publishes no prices and sells by quote. Its pricing page describes a fixed monthly platform fee plus variable fees by transaction count, with unlimited cards, users and control settings on the base Foundations plan.

facts.text: Spendesk says its rule sets can block spending until receipts are submitted.
Advanced workflows and policies is an optional add-on with no published price.
Spendesk says it charges no active user fees and no monthly card fees.
Spendesk states ISO 27001:2022 certification and a SOC 2 Type 2 badge appears on its security page.

plans.name: Foundations
plans.notes: Fixed monthly platform fee plus transaction-based fees; unlimited cards, users and control settings

hiddenCosts: Procurement, Accounts Payable, advanced workflows and policies, multi-entity management and HR and ERP integrations are add-ons with no published price.
Variable fees depend on the number of transactions, which include card purchases, invoice payments and expense claims.
